date_definitions.acquired_at: Recorded download date of a source response, when known; blank means unknown. Existing dates are preserved from legacy manifests, not revalidated acquisition timestamps.
date_definitions.observation_cutoff: Latest allowed observation period in an artifact, when established by its builder; not a download date.
date_definitions.built_at: Recorded date the derived artifact was generated, when known; not the source publication date.
date_definitions.scenario_reference_date: Reference date used by the scenario engine; does not assert that every later-added research artifact was acquired by that date.

legacy_provenance.status: Preserved historical source inventory. Its fetched_at values are acquisition records; most raw responses and transformations are absent from this repository.
legacy_provenance.refresh_scope: scripts/refresh_vintage.py downloads the HTTP(S) source URLs in gold/manifest.csv only; it cannot reconstruct the legacy gold tables.

unknown_dates: Do not infer dates from file modification times or replace missing dates with the scenario reference date.
checksum_scope: Checksums identify committed artifacts; they do not establish original source authenticity or complete raw-to-gold reproducibility.
